source: hermitdave/FrequencyWords, content/2018/de/de_50k.txt (OpenSubtitles 2018), top 10,300 tokens, lemmatized and filtered
attribution: German word list derived from FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave (https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords), built from OpenSubtitles 2018 (http://opus.nlpl.eu/OpenSubtitles2018.php); licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Lemmatized and filtered for this app; the derived list is shared under the same license.
method: Tokens in frequency order were lemmatized by hand (an LLM acting as scripts/build-wordlist.ts would): proper names, fillers/interjections, single letters, abbreviations, English words and profanity dropped; inflected forms mapped to their dictionary lemma; first rank wins. gender (nouns) is informational only.
